note: This is a repo-published ledger (same pattern as results.json and daily_notes.json), not local browser state.

featured.label: Featured Setup Only
featured.description: Only the ticker currently ranked #1 by Featured Setup (highest backtested return among tickers with ≥5 trades) is allowed.

diversified.label: Diversified
diversified.description: One position per volatility tier (High/Medium/Low), each the best-backtested ticker in that tier among those with ≥5 trades, equal-weighted. Forced one-per-tier even when a tier's best is weak — that's the point of testing diversification as a discipline rather than cherry-picking.

highconviction.label: High-Conviction Triggers
highconviction.description: Only tickers within 1.5% of their Watch-tab trigger level are eligible; among those, the one with the best backtested track record is picked.

discovered.label: Discovered Best
discovered.description: Always follows whatever the Discover tab's automated random search currently ranks as its single best-ever backtested combination. Replaced (old position closed, new one opened) whenever the search finds something that beats the current holding — a live forward-test of whatever the search turns up, not a fixed rule.
